notes: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B (dense: 48 Gated DeltaNet + 16 gated-attention layers, 27B parameters) as unsloth's Q8_0 GGUF (27.05 GiB, all weights in VRAM, tensor parallel over the two V100s (engine_args --tp 1), bnk's dense engine: src/dense, docs/DENSE.md). Q8_0 is the near-lossless quant that fits both cards with room for the context: the engine's per-layer output matches llama.cpp's fp32 CPU path within ~1% (quantized activations), top token identical on every prompt tested. The drafter is the model's own MTP block (mtp: builtin, in the same file: block 64); the draft head runs over run.sh's draft vocabulary. Sampling as the Qwen release recommends.
